items.q: What is GTC Financial Consultancy licensed to do?
items.a: GTC Financial Consultancy L.L.C. is licensed by the UAE Capital Market Authority under Category 5 (Licence No. 20200000211). This covers three activities: financial consultations, introduction to licensed financial service providers, and promotion of financial products and services where our licence permits.
Individuals and businesses in the UAE who want to understand financial products and services more clearly. Our team speaks Arabic and English.

items.q: Do you hold my money or act on my behalf?
items.a: No. We do not hold client money, manage funds, or carry out any transaction on your behalf. Our role is to explain and, if you choose, to introduce you to a licensed provider.

items.q: Do you give personal investment recommendations?
items.a: No. Our consultations provide general information to help you understand your options. Any decision is yours, and we encourage you to read the provider's documents and seek independent advice where needed.

items.q: How will I know who you are introducing me to?
items.a: Before any introduction, we tell you the provider's name, who regulates them, and what services they offer. You decide whether to proceed.

items.q: What happens to my personal data?
items.a: We use your details only to respond to your enquiry and provide the services you ask for, in line with our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>. We never sell your information.

items.q: What is GTC Financial Consultancy licensed to do?
items.a: GTC Financial Consultancy L.L.C. is licensed by the UAE Capital Market Authority under Category 5 (Licence No. 20200000211). This covers three activities: financial consultations, introduction to licensed financial service providers, and promotion of financial products and services where our licence permits.

items.q: How can I check your licence?
items.a: You can search for GTC Financial Consultancy L.L.C. or Licence No. 20200000211 in the register of licensed companies on the <cma>Capital Market Authority's website</cma>.

items.q: Are you part of a group?
items.a: Yes. We are part of GTC Group. Each company in the Group is a separate legal entity regulated where it operates. The services described on this website are provided only by GTC Financial Consultancy L.L.C., under its CMA licence.
Our office is at Office 2201, Nassima Tower, Trade Centre First, Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
Individuals and businesses in the UAE who want to understand financial products and services more clearly. Our team speaks Arabic and English.

items.q: Do you give personal investment recommendations?
items.a: No. Our consultations provide general information to help you understand your options. Any decision is yours, and we encourage you to read the provider's documents and seek independent advice where needed.

items.q: Do you hold my money or act on my behalf?
items.a: No. We do not hold client money, manage funds, or carry out any transaction on your behalf. Our role is to explain and, if you choose, to introduce you to a licensed provider.

items.q: Do you run seminars or educational events?
items.a: Yes. We hold seminars and publish educational content in Arabic and English that explain financial concepts in plain language. Upcoming events are announced on this website and on our social media channels.

items.q: How will I know who you are introducing me to?
items.a: Before any introduction, we tell you the provider's name, who regulates them, and what services they offer. You decide whether to proceed.

items.q: Do I have to go ahead after an introduction?
items.a: No. An introduction places you under no obligation. You can stop at any point, and you decide whether to use the provider's services.

items.q: Who is responsible for the services the provider gives me?
items.a: The provider. Its services are given under its own license, terms and documents, and your agreement for those services is with the provider, not with GTC Financial Consultancy L.L.C. Please refer to the provider's agreements and policies carefully before you decide.
